column1: # Package licenses for every NuGet package in the published RealmPortal.App deps.json (linux-x64 and win-x64).
# Columns (tab-separated): package id, exact version, license (as declared by the package), license folder under licenses/nuget/, source of the files.
# packaging/collect-licenses.sh fails the build if a published package has no row here; NuGetLicenseManifestTests check it against the lock file.
